# Principal Software Engineer Resume Templates - ATS-Optimized

Professional Principal Software Engineer resume templates designed for senior technical leadership roles. Highlight your system architecture experience and technical leadership skills with ATS-friendly formatting.

Each resume has been vetted by recruiters, is optimized to pass ATS and recruitment software, and is downloadable/editable for free.

A Principal Software Engineer leads technical architecture decisions, mentors senior developers, and drives engineering strategy across multiple teams. They design scalable systems, establish coding standards, and solve the most complex technical challenges while collaborating with product and executive leadership.
